# Garden Route Restaurants
> The most complete restaurant directory for the Garden Route, South Africa.

## What this site is
gardenroute-restaurants.co.za is a restaurant directory covering the Garden Route region of the Western Cape, South Africa. It lists restaurants across Knysna, Plettenberg Bay, Wilderness, George, Mossel Bay, Sedgefield, and Storms River.

All data is sourced from Google Places and enriched with AI-written descriptions. Listings include ratings, reviews, opening hours, cuisine type, price range, contact information, and directions.

## Who this is for
Tourists visiting the Garden Route, locals looking for new dining experiences, and travellers planning road trips along the N2.

## Coverage
- Towns: Knysna, Plettenberg Bay, Wilderness, George, Mossel Bay, Sedgefield, Storms River
- Region: Garden Route, Western Cape, South Africa
- Data updated: Weekly (every Sunday)

## Key pages
- Homepage: https://www.gardenroute-restaurants.co.za
- Browse all: https://www.gardenroute-restaurants.co.za/browse
- By town: https://www.gardenroute-restaurants.co.za/towns
- Sitemap: https://www.gardenroute-restaurants.co.za/sitemap.xml

## Data sources
- Google Places API (ratings, reviews, hours, contact info)
- Claude AI (descriptions, cuisine classification, tags)

## Licensing
Restaurant information is factual and sourced from public data. Free to reference and cite.
